Now

This is a now page and was last updated on 19/09/2026.

Life

The start of the summer was hard; there was a heatwave around here, and I had many sleepless (and sweaty) nights. Thank goodness it's over now. We also just installed an air conditioning unit, so this will be my last summer with no aircon! 🥹

We're currently doing renovations around the house, and everything is so dusty all the time, bleh. But this is a "problem" that past me would definitely have been glad to have.

Lately I've been taking my health more seriously, and I've noticed important improvements, especially in my mental space (basically, my baseline anxiety had been high for so long, I didn't realize it until I actually got better and noticed the difference 🥲). The improved mental health also makes taking care of my physical health less of a chore. I hope to get buff AF lol.

Work

Yep, still working for the same company. In Spring I joined a new project, which involved a new team, new technologies... and it was hard to adjust (mostly because of my not-so-ideal mental space at the time). In preparation, I spent many hours learning, revising and taking notes. Thankfully the transition went well, and I can finally rest easy. For now! Haha.

Bro, do you even read?

I AM READING, IN FACT! (Can you tell I've been feeling better lately???).

In the past months I've finished a few books; including a couple of crime novels, which are fast to read and boost my motivation to keep going.

Right now I'm slowly reading Your Beauty Mark, by Dita Von Teese; I bought it second-hand but came in excellent condition. I had to buy a Bookseat (also second-hand lol) to be able to read it comfortably, because it's a big book - but it's a beautiful tome, with quality paper, full of color photographs... so luxurious, worth the purchase. It's a fascinating read; I'm loving Dita's beauty philosophy, and it's encouraging me to keep taking better care of myself.

Also, I found an abridged version of The Wheel of Time saga, and it's going to be a lifesaver. I had put this series on hiatus after finishing book 6, because I wanted to know the story but the pacing was driving me nuts.

Watching

  • Live-action shows (I'm binging so much anime, I feel like I need to make the distinction): I finally started watching Community, which had been in my watchlist for a long time. It's good! I finally know where the pizza meme comes from.
  • Anime: The most notable one is Monster ; I had started watching it back in the day, but never finished it. And... wow. It's a gem, is all I can say, and the soundtrack is eerily beautiful.

Playing

I remembered my beloved Wario Land and played a bit on our Switch 2; I want to amass a fortune, so Wario can have the best castle!

Also, husbando bought Pokopia for me, because he knew I would like it. And who am I kidding: I absolutely love that game. In fact, I think it's ruined ACNH for me haha.
